_comment: The complete corresponding source of the LGPL-3.0 libraries the installers carry (Qt and PySide6 6.11.2, the versions in packaging/constraints.txt). The release workflow downloads each archive, checks its size and SHA-256, and attaches it to the release (owner's decision D8, docs/legal/OBLIGATIONS.md). Sizes and hashes from the mirrorlist pages on download.qt.io, read 2026-11-10.
